intro.title: Connecting Property Owners with Trusted Service Providers
intro.p1: We provide a smart platform that connects property owners — including commercial spaces, banks, malls, and residential units — with professional service providers in cleaning, maintenance, and security. Our goal is to simplify the process of finding, comparing, and managing services through a reliable and efficient digital experience, helping businesses save time, reduce costs, and ensure quality.
intro.p2: Through our platform, clients can easily post service requests, receive multiple competitive offers, and choose the most suitable provider based on pricing, experience, and verified reviews. We streamline communication between both parties, ensuring clarity, transparency, and faster decision-making at every step.

about.visionText: To become the leading platform in the region for property service solutions — setting a new standard for trust, quality and convenience in the industry, while empowering service providers to grow and property owners to operate smarter.
about.missionText: To simplify and modernize how property services are sourced and managed by connecting property owners with trusted, high-quality service providers through a seamless digital platform that prioritizes efficiency, transparency, and reliability.
about.story1: The idea started from a common challenge faced by many property owners and businesses: finding reliable service providers for essential tasks like cleaning, maintenance and security. The process was often time-consuming, inconsistent, and lacked transparency.
about.story2: Recognizing this gap, we set out to build a solution that brings structure, trust and efficiency to the industry. By leveraging technology, we created a platform that simplifies the way property owners request services, receive competitive offers, and select the right provider for managing ongoing operations.
about.story3: What began as a simple idea has evolved into a fully integrated ecosystem that is transforming how property services are sourced and experienced.

services.subtitle: We offer a comprehensive range of property services designed to meet the needs of commercial and residential spaces, ensuring efficiency, reliability, and high-quality standards.
services.cleaningDesc: Professional cleaning solutions tailored for offices, malls, banks, and residential properties. We provide routine cleaning, deep cleaning, and specialized services using trained staff and high-quality equipment.
services.maintenanceDesc: High end-to-end maintenance solutions covering electrical, plumbing, HVAC, and general repairs. Our service providers ensure quick response times and reliable execution to keep your property running smoothly.
services.securityDesc: Reliable and professional security solutions for commercial and residential properties. From trained security personnel to advanced monitoring support, we help ensure a safe and secure environment.
services.fireSafetyDesc: Specialized services to ensure your property meets safety regulations and is fully equipped to handle emergencies.
services.landscapingDesc: Comprehensive care for outdoor spaces including gardens, green areas, and parking lots. We ensure your property maintains a clean, attractive, and welcoming exterior.
services.relocationDesc: End-to-end moving solutions for offices and residential units with minimal disruption.

owners.subtitle: Our platform simplifies the process of connecting property owners with trusted service providers through a seamless, step-by-step experience.
owners.step1Desc: Easily post a service request through our platform. Describe what you need: cleaning, maintenance or any other service.
owners.step2Desc: Qualified providers review your request and submit competitive offers tailored to your project needs.
owners.step3Desc: Compare proposals on pricing, experience and reviews — then select the best fit with full transparency.
owners.costDesc: Receive multiple offers and choose the best value for your service request.
owners.qualityDesc: Work only with vetted, qualified providers reviewed by other property owners.
owners.timeDesc: Eliminate the search: comparing, vetting and assigning happens in one place.
owners.transparencyDesc: Clear pricing, timelines and protocols — no hidden fees or surprises.

providers.subtitle: We welcome professional service providers to join our growing network and gain access to a wide range of business opportunities across commercial and residential properties.
providers.step1Desc: Service providers register easily and create their profile in minutes.
providers.step2Desc: Upload company information and required supporting documentation.
providers.step3Desc: Our team reviews your profile and onboards approved providers quickly.

faq.title: Everything you
faq.subtitle: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: How often do you update the library?
faq.a1: We continuously expand and refresh our service provider library. New verified vendors are added weekly to ensure you always have access to the best in the industry.
faq.q2: Can I get a free trial?
faq.a2: Yes — property owners can post their first service request and review competitive offers at no cost. You only pay when you choose a provider.
faq.q3: Do you have a monthly plan?
faq.a3: We offer flexible monthly subscriptions for both property owners and service providers, with tiered features to suit operations of any size.
faq.q4: Do you have discounts for students and educators?
faq.a4: Yes. Verified students and educators can request a custom discount via our contact form.
faq.q5: What forms of payment do you accept?
faq.a5: We accept all major credit cards, bank transfers, Apple Pay and Mada — invoices are issued automatically.

privacy.subtitle: We are committed to protecting your personal information and being transparent about how we collect, use, and safeguard your data.
privacy.intro: This privacy policy describes how Atheer ("we", "us", "our") collects, uses, shares, and protects your personal information when you use our website, mobile applications, and related services.
privacy.section1Body1: Personal Information: name, email address, phone number, billing details, and any information you provide when contacting us.
privacy.section1Body2: Usage Data: information about how you interact with our platform, including pages visited and time spent.
privacy.section1Body3: Cookies: data stored in your browser to improve user experience and analyze traffic.
privacy.section2Body1: Provide, maintain, and improve our products and services.
privacy.section2Body2: Communicate with you, including updates, marketing messages and customer support.
privacy.section2Body3: Process payments, prevent fraud, and ensure security.
privacy.section2Body4: Comply with applicable laws and regulations.
privacy.section3Body1: We do not sell your personal information. We may share it in the following cases:
privacy.section3Body2: With trusted service providers who assist in operating our platform.
privacy.section3Body3: To comply with legal obligations or respond to lawful requests by public authorities.
privacy.section3Body4: In connection with a business transaction, such as a merger, acquisition or sale of assets.
privacy.section4Body1: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data. However, no method of transmission over the Internet is 100% secure.
privacy.section5Body1: Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have the right to:
privacy.section5Body2: Access, correct, or delete your data.
privacy.section5Body3: Object to or restrict the processing of your information.
privacy.section5Body4: Withdraw consent where processing is based on consent.

privacy.section7Body1: Our services may contain links to third-party websites. We are not responsible for the privacy practices or content of those websites.
privacy.section8Body1: Your information may be transferred to and processed in countries other than your own. We take steps to ensure adequate protection in line with applicable laws.
privacy.section9Body1: Our services are not directed to individuals under the age of 13. If we become aware of personal information collected from a child without parental consent, we will delete it promptly.

testimonials.title: Client's Reviews
testimonials.review1: The platform made it incredibly easy to find a reliable cleaning company for our office building. Within hours we received multiple offers and selected the best fit at fair pricing.
testimonials.review2: We've struggled for years with inconsistent maintenance services. This platform gave us access to professional providers we trust, with clear pricing and fast response times.
testimonials.review3: As a service provider, the platform helped us grow our business and connect with serious clients without spending heavily on marketing.
testimonials.review4: The transparency and review system gave us confidence in choosing the right security provider. The process was smooth from start to finish.
testimonials.case1Desc: A mid-sized office building was facing recurring maintenance issues and delays. Through our platform, the client received multiple offers from qualified providers, selected an ideal partner, and reduced issue resolution time by over 40% while maintaining cost.
testimonials.case2Desc: A retail mall required a higher standard of cleanliness and maintenance consistency. By switching to a new service provider through our platform, they improved cleaning quality, implemented structured cleaning schedules and outperformed their visitor experience.
testimonials.case3Title: High Security Services for Residential Compound
testimonials.case3Desc: A residential compound needed a trusted security solution. Within hours of posting on the platform, professionals using our platform connected with a vetted security company, resulting in improved safety standards and higher resident satisfaction.
